G1801.def:
ἐνωτίζομαι
(οὖς),
depon. mid.,
[in LXX chiefly for אָזַן hi. ;]
to give ear to, hearken to: with accusative, At 2:14.†
Also used for יָחַל שָׁמַע
(AS)

G1802.def:
Ἐνώχ (Heb. חֲנוֹךְ), ὁ,
Enoch (Gn 5:18): Lc 3:37, Hb 11:5, Ju 14.†
(AS)

G1803.def:
ἕξ, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl.,
six: Mt 17:1, Lc 13:14, al.
(AS)

G1804.def:
ἐξ-αγγέλλω
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;]
to tell out, proclaim: 1Pe 2:9 [Mc 16:1-20, "shorter conclusion"] (Cremer, 29).†
(AS)

G1805.def:
ἐξ-αγοράζω
[in LXX: καιρόν ὑμεῖς ἐξαγοράζετε (זְבַן), Dan LXX TH Dn 2:8 * ;]
__1. to redeem, ransom (esp. of slaves): metaphorically, Gl 3:13 4:5.
__2. to buy up; mid., to buy up for oneself: τ. καιρόν, Ef 5:16, Cl 4:5 (Cremer, 60).†
(AS)

G1806.def:
ἐξ-άγω
[in LXX chiefly for יָצָא hi. ;]
to lead out: with accusative, Mc 15:20, Jo 10:3, At 5:19 7:36 16:37-39; before ἔξω, Lc 24:50; ἐκ, At 7:40 12:17 13:17, Hb 8:9; εἰς, At 21:38.†
(AS)

G1807.def:
ἐξ-αιρέω -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for נָצַל hi. ;]
to take out: with accusative, ὀφθαλμόν, Mt 5:29 18:9; mid.
__(a) to take out for oneself, choose: At 26:17 (Thayer, see word; Page, Ac., l.with, but see infr.);
__(b) to deliver: At 7:10, 34" (LXX) At 12:11 At 23:27 At 26:17 (EV, but see supr.), Gl 1:4.†
(AS)

G1808.def:
ἐξ-αίρω
[in LXX for נָסַע, יָרַשׁ hi., כָּרַת ni., מוּת, בָּעַר pi., etc. ;]
to lift up, lift off the earth, remove: 1Co 5:13 (LXX)†
(AS)

G1809.def:
ἐξ-αιτέω, -ῶ
to ask from; mid., to ask for oneself, demand: aor., ἐξῃτήσατο, with accusative (obtained you by asking, R, mg.), Lc 22:31 (see Field, Notes, 76; Cremer, 73).†
(AS)

G1810.def:
ἐξ-αίφνης (WH, ἐξέφνης, exc. At 22:6; see App., p. 151, and cf. M, Pr., 35), adv.
(ἄφνω), [in LXX chiefly for פִּתְאוֹם ;]
suddenly Mc 13:36, Lc 2:13 9:39, At 9:3 22:6.†
(AS)

G1811.def:
ἐξ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX Am 2:4, Jr 2:2 (אַחַר הָלַךְ), Is 56:11 (פָּנָה), Jó 31:9 (פָּתָה ni.), Sir.5:2, Dan LXX TH Dn 3:1-30 :(41) * ;]
to follow, follow up (in various senses): metaphorically, 2Pe 1:16 2:2 2:15 †
(AS)

G1813.def:
ἐξ-αλείφω
[in LXX for טוּחַ, Lv 14:42, al.; metaphorically, מָחָה, שָׁחַת, etc. ;]
__1. to plaster, wash over (LXX).
__2. to wipe off, wipe out: δάκρυον, Ap 7:17 21:4; metaphorically, χειρόγραφον, Cl 2:14; τ. ὄνομα, before ἐκ, Ap 3:5 (MM, Exp., xiii); pass., ἀμαρτίαι (ἐξαλιφθῆναι, WH), At 3:19 (cf. Sl 51:11 Sl 109:13, Is 43:25, Sir.46:20 (ἁμ. ἀπαλ-), 3Ma.2:19).†
(AS)

G1814.def:
ἐξ-άλλομαι
[in LXX for קָלַל (Hc 1:8), etc. ;]
to leap up: At 3:8.†
(AS)

G1815.def:
ἐξ-ανάστασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐξανίστημι),
a rising again: ἐκ τ. νεκρῶν, Fp 3:11 (Cremer, 308).†
(AS)

G1816.def:
ἐξ-ανα-τέλλω
[in LXX: Gn 2:9, Sl 104:14 Sl 132:17 Sl 147:8 (צָמַח hi.); Sl 112:4 (זָרַח) * ;]
__1. trans., to cause to spring up (LXX).
__2. Intrans. (as ἀνατέλλω, Gn 3:18), to spring up: Mt 13:5, Mc 4:5.†
(AS)

G1817.def:
ἐξ-ανίσημι
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;]
__1. trans., to raise up: σπέρμα (cf. Gn 38:8), Mc 12:19, Lc 20:28.
__2. In 2 aor. act., intrans., to rise: At 15:5.†
(AS)

G1818.def:
ἐξ -απατάω, -ῶ strengthened form of ἀπατάω,
[in LXX: Êx 8:29 (הָתַל hi.), Da TH Sus 5:6* ;]
to deceive: with accusative, Rm 7:11 Rm 16:18, 1Co 3:18, 2Co 11:3, 2Ts 2:3; pass., 1Tm 2:14.†
(AS)

G1819.def:
ἐξάπινα = ἐξαπίνης, ἐξαίφνης (which see),
[in LXX for פִּתְאוֹם, etc. ;]
suddenly: Mc 9:8.†
(AS)

G1820.def:
ἐξ-απορέω, -ῶ
[in LXX, pass., for פּוּן, Sl 88:15 * ;]
so in NT, depon. pass., to be utterly at a loss, be in despair: absol. (as Ps, l.with), 2Co 4:8; τοῦ ζῆν, 2Co 1:8.†
(AS)

G1821.def:
ἐξ-απο-στέλλω
[in LXX freq., chiefly for שָׁלַח pi. ;]
__1. to send forth: with accusative of person(s), At 7:12 12:11, Gl 4:4; τ. ἐπαγγελίαν, Lc 24:49; τ. πνεῦμα, Gl 4:6; [τ. κήρυγμα, Mc 16:1-20, "shorter conclusion," WH ;] before εἰς, At 22:21; pass., ὁ λόγος, At 13:26.
__2. to send away: with accusative of person(s), before εἰς, At 9:30; before ἕως, At 11:22; with inf., At 17:14; κενόν, Lc 1:53 20:10-11.†
(AS)

G1822.def:
ἐξ-αρτίζω
(ἄρτιος), [in LXX. Êx 28:7 (חָבַר pu.) * ;]
__1. to com­plete, finish: τ. ἡμέρας, At 21:5.
__2. to furnish, supply: pass., 2Tm 3:17 (for exx., see MM, Exp., xiii; Cremer, 651).†
(AS)

G1823.def:
ἐξ-αστράπτω
[in LXX: Nm 3:3 (בָּרָק), Eze.1:4 (לָקַח hithp.) 17 Dan LXX 106 (קָלַל)* ;]
to flash like lightning, gleam, be radiant: ἱματισμός, Lc 9:29.†
(AS)

G1824.def:
ἐξ-αυτῆς
(a κοινή word, = ἐξ αὐτῆς τ. ὥρας)
at once, forthwith: Mc 6:25, At 10:33 At 11:11 At 21:32 At 23:30, Fp 2:23.†
(AS)

G1825.def:
ἐξ-εγείρω
[in LXX for עוּר ni., hi., etc. ;]
to raise up: Rm 9:17 (cf. ICC, in l); from the dead, 1Co 6:14.†
(AS)

G1826.def:
ἔξ-ειμι
(εἶμι),
to go forth: At 13:42 At 17:15 At 20:7; before ἐπί, with accusative, At 27:43.†
(AS)

G1828.def:
ἐξ-έλκω
[in LXX: Gn 37:28 (מָשַׁךְ), etc. ;]
to draw out or away: metaphorically, ὑπὸ τ. ἐπιθυμίας, Tg 1:14 (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G1830.def:
ἐξ-εραυνάω
(Rec. ἐξερευνάω), -ῶ, [in LXX for חָקַר, נָצַר, etc. ;]
to search out, search carefully: before περί, 1Pe 1:10.†
(AS)

G1831.def:
ἐξέρχομαι,
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for יצא, also for עלה ,בּוֹא, etc. ;] depon.,
to go, or come out of: Mt 10:11, Mc 1:35, Jo 13:30, al.; with inf., Mt 11:8, Mc 3:21, Lc 7:25, 26 At 20:8; id. before ἐπί, Mt 26:55, al.; εἰς, Mc 1:38; ἵνα, Ap 6:2; ἐ. before ἐκ (cl. with genitive loc.), Mc 5:2, Jo 4:30, al.; ἔξω, with genitive, Mt 21:17, Mc 14:68, At 16:13, Hb 13:13; ἀπό, Mc 11:12, Lc 9:5, Fp 4:15; ἐκεῖθεν, Mt 15:21, Mc 6:1, Lc 9:4, al.; of demons expelled, before ἐκ (ἀπό), with genitive of person(s), Mc 1:25, 26 5:8, Lc 4:35, al.; of prisoners released, Mt 5:26, At 16:40; ptcp., ἐξελθών, with indic., of verb of departure (cf. Dalman, Words, 20f.), Mt 8:32 15:21 24:1, Mc 16:8, Lc 22:39, At 12:9, 17 al. Metaphorical,
__(a) of persons: 2Co 6:17, 1Jo 2:19; of birth or origin, Mt 2:6 (LXX), Hb 7:5 (cf . Gn 35:11); of escape from danger, ἐκ τ. χειρὸς αὐτῶν, Jo 10:39; of public appearance, 1Jo 4:1;
__(b) of things: Mt 24:27; esp. of utterances, reports, proclamations: φωνή, Ap 16:17 19:5; φήμη, Mt 9:26, Lc 4:14; ἀκοή, Mc 1:28; λόγος, Jo 21:23; δόγμα, Lc 2:1 (cf. δι-εξέρχομαι).
(AS)

G1832.def:
ἔξ-εστι
(εἰμί),
impers. verb.,
it is permitted, lawful: Mc 2:24, At 8:37 (R, mg.), 1Co 10:23; with inf., Mt 12:2, 10 12 14:4 15:26 19:3 22:17 27:6, Mc 3:4 12:14, Lc 6:2, 9 14:3, Jo 5:10; before accusative, Mc 2:26, Lc 6:4 20:22; with dative of person(s) and inf., Mt 20:15, Mc 6:18 10:2, Jo 18:31, At 16:21 21:37 22:25 (inf. understood), 1Co 6:12; ἐξόν (sc. ἐστί), At 2:29, 2Co 12:4; ἐξὸν ἦν, Mt 12:4.†
(AS)

G1833.def:
ἐξ-ετάζω
(ἐτάζω (rare), to examine), [in LXX: Dt 13:14-15 Dt 19:18, 1Cr 28:9 A (דָּרַשׁ), דָּרַשׁ), Sl 11:5-6 (בָּחַן), Wis.6:3, Sir.3:21, al. ;]
to examine closely, inquire carefully (of ): before περί (with ἀκριβῶς), Mt 2:8; before τίς, Mt 10:11; with accusative of person(s), Jo 21:12.†
SYN.: ἀνακρίνω, ἐραυνάω (see DCG, ii, 594b) (AS)

G1834.def:
ἐξ-ηγέομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;]
to lead, show the way; metaphorically, to unfold, narrate, declare: with accusative of thing(s), Lc 24:35 At 21:19; with dative of person(s), At 10:8; θεόν (understood), Jo 1:18; before ὅσα, At 15:12; καθώς, At 15:14.†
(AS)

G1835.def:
ἑξήκοντα, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl.,
sixty: Mt 13:8, 23, Mc 4:8, 20, Lc 24:13, 1Tm 5:9, Ap 11:3 Ap 12:6 Ap 13:18.†
(AS)

G1836.def:
ἑξῆς
adv. (ἔχω),
in order, successively, next: τῇ ἑ. ἡμέρᾳ, Lc 9:37; ἐν τῷ ἑ. (sc. χρόνῳ), soon after, Lc 7:11; τῇ ἑ. (sc. ἡμέρα), At 21:1 At 25:17 At 27:18.†
(AS)

G1837.def:
ἐξ-ηχέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jl 3:14 (הָמוֹן), Sir.40:13, 3Ma.3:2 * ;]
to sound forth (as a trumpet, or thunder; see M, Th., l.with): pass., 1Ts 1:8.†
(AS)

G1838.def:
ἐξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἔχω), [in LXX, cf. Sir, prol.9 ;]
habit, use, experience: Hb 5:14.†
(AS)

G1839.def:
ἐξ-ίστημι (also in Hellenistic -ιστάνω, Act 8:9),
[in LXX for H2730, etc. (29 words in all) ;],
__1. causal in Pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to put out of its place; metaphorically, ἐ. τινά φρενῶν (Eur.), to drive one out of his senses, hence, absol., to confound, amaze: with accusative of person(s), Lc 24:22, At 8:9, 11.
__2. Intr. in pass. and mid., also in 2 aor., pf., plpf. act., before ἐκ or with genitive, to stand aside from, retire from; esp. τ. φρενῶν, to lose one's senses (Eur.), hence, absol.;
__(a) to be beside oneself, be mad: Mc 3:21, 2Co 5:13 (opposite to σωφρονεῖν);
__(b) to be amazed, confounded: Mt 12:23, Mc 2:12 Mc 5:42 Mc 6:51, Lc 2:47 Lc 8:56, At 2:7, 12 At 8:13 At 9:21 At 10:45 At 12:16 (Cremer, 309).†
(AS)

G1840.def:
ἐξ-ισχύω
[in LXX: Sir.7:6 * ;]
to have strength enough, to be quite able: with inf., Ef 3:18.†
(AS)

G1841.def:
ἔξ-οδος, -ου, ὁ
(ὁδός), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹצָא also חוּץ, etc. ;]
a going out, departure: Hb 11:22; of death, Lc 9:31, 2Pe 1:15.†
(AS)

G1842.def:
έξ-ολεθρεύω
(so best MSS. and WH; also read -οθρεύω), [in LXX frequently (rare in Gk. writers) for כָּרַת ni., hi., etc. ;]
to destroy utterly: before ἐκ τ. λαοῦ, At 3:23 (LXX).†
(AS)

G1843.def:
ἐξ-ομολογέω, -ῶ and depon. mid., -έομαι, -οῦμαι
[as always in LXX chiefly for יָדָה hi. ;]
__1. act. = cl. ὁμολογέω, to profess or agree to do (Field, Notes, 75): Lc 22:6.
__2. Mid., to acknowledge, confess (MM, Exp., xiv): τ. ἁμαρτίας, Mt 3:6, Mc 1:5, Tg 5:16; τ. πράξεις, At 19:18; before ὅτι, Fp 2:11; with dative of person(s), to make acknowledgment to one's honour, to praise, give praise to (as in LXX; Kennedy, Sources, 118): Rm 14:11(LXX) Rm 15:9 (LXX); before ὅτι, Mt 11:25, Lc 10:21 (Cremer, 771).†
(AS)

G1844.def:
ἐξ-ορκίζω
(later form of ἐξορκόω ), [in LXX: Jz 17:2 (אָלָה), Gn 24:3, 3Ki.22:16 (שָׁבַע hi.)* ;]
__1. to administer an oath to (Dem., Polyb., al.).
__2. to adjure: with accusative of person(s), before κατά, with genitive (as frequently in magic π.; MM, Exp., xiv), Mt 26:63.†
(AS)

G1845.def:
ἐξ-ορκιστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐξορκίζω),
__1. one who administers an oath.
__2. an exorcist: At 19:13.†
(AS)

G1846.def:
ἐξ-ορύσσω
[in LXX: Pv 29:22; ὀφθαλμόν (-ούς), Jz 16:21, 1Rs 11:2 (נָקַר)* ;]
to dig out, dig up: στέγην, Mc 2:4; metaphorically, ὀφοαλμούς (cf. LXX, ll with; Herod., viii, 116), Gl 4:15.†
(AS)

G1847.def:
ἐξ-ουδενέω
(Rec. -όω; T, -θανόω), -ῶ, [in LXX (with vv. ll. -όω, -θενέω, -θενόω) for בּוּז, בָּזָה, מָאַס, בּוּס, etc. ;]
to despise, set at nought: Mc 9:12 (cf. ἐξουθενέω).†
(AS)

G1848.def:
ἐξ-ουθενέω, -ῶ
(οὐθείς, which see), [in LXX (see: ἐξουθενέω): 1Rs 2:30, al., and as seel. for -δενέω, -όω, -θενόω* ;]
to set at nought, despise utterly, treat with contempt: with accusative of person(s), Lc 18:9 23:11, Rm 14:3, 10, 1Co 16:11; with accusative of thing(s), Gl 4:14, 1Ts 5:20; pass., of persons: Mc 9:12 (T, -όω), 1Co 6:4; of things λίθος, At 4:11 (LXX ἀπεδοκίμασαν); λόγος, 2Co 10:10; τὰ ἐξουθενημένα, 1Co 1:28.†
SYN.: ἀθετέω, καταφρονέω (see DCG, i, 453b) (AS)

G1849.def:
ἐξουσία, -ας, ἡ
(ἔξεστι), [in LXX: 4Ki.20:13, Psa.113 (114):2 135 (136)8, 9, Is 39:2, Jer.28 (51):28 (מֶמְשָׁלָה), frequently in Da for Aram. שָׁלְטָן, etc., Wis.10:14, Sir.9:13, al. ;]
__1. prop., liberty or power to act, freedom to exercise the inward force or faculty expressed by δύναμις (which see): 1Co 9:12; ἐ. ἔχειν, 2Ts 3:9; id. before inf., Jo 10:18, 1Co 9:4, 5; with genitive obj., Rm 9:21; before ἐπί, with accusative, Ap 22:14; περί, 1Co 7:37.
__2. Later (cf. Milligan, Th., 114; MM, Exp., xiv), of the power of right, authority: Mt 21:33, Mc 11:28, Lc 20:2; of Messianic authority, Mt 9:6, Mc 2:10, al.; of apostolic authority, 2Co 10:8 13:10; of the authority of government: Mt 8:9 28:18, Ju 25, Ap 12:10, al.; esp. of judicial authority, Lc 20:20, Jo 19:10, 11.
__3. Meton.,
__(a) jurisdiction: Lc 23:7 (cf. 1Ma.6:11, Is 39:2);
__(b) a ruler or magistrate: Rm 13:1-3; pl., Lc 12:11, Rm 13:1, Tt 3:1;
__(with) of supramundane powers (syn. with ἀρχή, δύναμις, θρόνος, κυριότης): 1Co 15:24, Ef 1:21 3:10, Cl 2:10, 1Pe 3:22, al. (Cremer. 236).
SYN.: see: δύναμις. (AS)

G1850.def:
ἐξουσιάζω
(ἐξουσία) [in LXX (frequently in Ec) chiefly for שָׁלַט ;]
__1. to exercise authority (Arist.).
__2. Trans., to exercise authority over: with genitive of person(s), Lc 22:25; with genitive of thing(s), 1Co 7:4; pass., to be held under authority (see Lft., Notes, 214): before ὑπό, 1Co 6:12.†
(AS)

G1851.def:
ἐξοχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐξέχω, to stand out), [in LXX for שֵׁן, Jó 39:28 * ;]
__1. a projection (ἐ. πέτρας, Jó 39:28).
__2. Metaphorical, eminence, excellence: οἱ κατ᾽ ἐ., the chief men, At 25:23.†
(AS)

G1852.def:
ἐξ-υπνίζω
[in LXX: Jz 16:14, 20, 3Ki.3:13 (יָקַץ), Jó 14:12 (עוּר ni.)* ;]
to awaken out of sleep (= ἀφυπνίζω): with accusative of person(s), Jo 11:11.†
(AS)

G1853.def:
ἔξ-υπνος, -ον
(ὕπνος), [in LXX: I Et 3:3 * ;]
roused out of sleep: At 16:27.†
(AS)

G1854.def:
ἔξω
adv. (ἐξ), [in LXX for חוּץ ;]
__1. outside, without;
__(a) adverbially: Mt 12:46, Mc 3:31 11:4, Lc 8:20, Jo 18:16, al.; with art., ὁ ἔ., he who is without; metaphorically, in pl., οἱ ἔ., of those outside the Church, 1Co 5:12-13, Cl 4:5 (Lft., in l), 1Ts 4:12; ὁ ἔ. ἄνθρωπος, 2Co 4:16; αἱ ἔ. πόλεις, At 26:11;
__(b) as prep. with genitive: Lc 13:33, At 21:5, Hb 13:11-12
__2. After verbs of motion;
__(a) adverbially, forth, out: Mt 5:13 Mc 14:68, Lc 22:62, Jo 19:4, 13, At 9:40, al.;
__(b) as prep. with genitive, out of: Mt 21:17, Mc 11:19 12:8, Lc 4:29, At 7:58, Hb 13:13, al
(AS)

G1855.def:
ἔξωθεν
adv. (ἔξω opposite to ἔσωθεν), [in LXX for חוּץ ;]
__1. prop. (in answer to the question, Whence ?), from without: Mc 7:18
__2. More often (= ἔξω; cf. Bl., § 25, 3), without: Mt 23:27-28 Mc 7:18, 2Co 7:5; τὸ ἔ., Mt 23:25, Lc 11:39-40; οἱ ἔ., 1Tm 3:7, Mc 4:11 (WH, mg.); ὁ ἔ. κόσμος, 1Pe 3:3; ἐκβάλλειν ἔ., Ap 11:2. As prep. with genitive: Mc 7:15, Ap 11:1-19 4Ki.14:20 (cf. Robertson, Gr., 548).†
(AS)

G1856.def:
ἐξ-ωθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for נָדָה hi. ;]
__1. to thrust out: At 7:45.
__2. to drive out of the sea, drive on shore: At 27:39 (WH, txt., ἐκσῶσαι).†
*ἐκ-σώζω,
to preserve from danger, bring safe: At 27:39 (ἐξῶσαι, WH, mg., R, txt., see: ἐξωθέω).†
ἐξ-ωθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for נָדָה hi. ;]
__1. to thrust out: At 7:45.
__2. to drive out of the sea, drive on shore: At 27:39 (WH, txt., ἐκσῶσαι).†
*ἐκ-σώζω,
to preserve from danger, bring safe: At 27:39 (ἐξῶσαι, WH, mg., R, txt., see: ἐξωθέω).†
(AS)

G1857.def:
ἐξώτερος, -α, -ον
(compar., from ἔξω; opposite to ἐσώτερος) [in LXX chiefly for חִיצוֹן ;]
outer: σκότος, Mt 8:12 Mt 22:13 Mt 25:30.†
(AS)

G1859.def:
ἑορτή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX for חַג (chiefly), מוֹעֵד ;]
a feast, festival: Lc 2:42, Jo 5:1, Jo 6:4 Jo 7:37, Cl 2:10; ἡ ἑ. τοῦ πάσχα, Lc 2:41, Jo 13:1; τ. ἀζύμων, Lc 22:1; ἡ σκηνοπηγία, Jo 7:2 (Deiss., LAE, 116); ἐν τ. ἑ., Mt 26:5, Mc 14:2, Jo 4:45 7:11 12:20 (εἶναι ἐν ἑ.), Jo 2:23; εἰς τ. ἑ. (for the feast), Jo 13:29; ἀναβαίνειν, ἔρχεσθαι εἰς τ. ἑ., Jo 4:45 7:8-10 11:56 12:12; τῆς ἐ μεσούσης, Jo 7:14; κατὰ ἑ. (at each feast), Mt 27:15, Mc 15:6, Lc 23:17, R, mg.; τ. ἑ. ποιεῖν, At 18:21; κατὰ τὸ ἔθος τῆς ἑ., Lc 2:42.†
(AS)

G1860.def:
ἐπ-αγγελία, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπαγγέλλω), [in LXX: Sl 56:8 (סֵפֶר), etc. ;]
__1. a summons (as Attic law-term, Dem., al.).
__2. a promise (Dem., Arist., al.): At 23:21; esp. in NT of the divine promises, At 7:17, Rm 4:14, 16 Rm 9:4, Gl 3:17-18, 21 4:23, Hb 8:6 11:9, 17, 2Pe 3:9; with inf., Hb 4:1; γίνεται, etc., with dative of person(s), At 2:39, Rm 4:13, Gl 3:16; before πρός, At 13:32 26:6; έπαγγέλεσθαι τὴν ἐ., 1Jo 2:25; ἔχειν ἐπαγγελίας, Hb 7:6, 2Co 7:1; εἷναι νἐ έπαγγελίᾳ, Ef 6:2; ἡ γῆ τῆς ἐ., Hb 11:9; τὰ τέκνα τῆς ἐ., Rm 9:8, Gl 4:28; τ. πνεῦμα τῆς ἐ. τ. ἅγιον, Ef 1:13; αἱ διαθῆκαι τῆς ἐ., Ef 2:12; ἡ ἐ. τ. θεοῦ, Rm 4:20; pl., 2Co 1:20; αἱ ἐ. τ. πατέρων, Rm 15:8; with genitive obj., τ. ζωῆς (see Dalman, Words, 103), 1Tm 4:8; τ. παρουσίας αὐτοῦ, 2Pe 3:4; κατ ̓ ἐπαγγελίαν, At 13:23, Gl 3:29, 2Tm 1:1; δι ̓ ἐπαγγελίας, Gl 3:18; συμμέτοχα τῆς ἐ., Ef 3:6; λόγος ἐπαγγελίας, Rm 9:9. By meton. (cf. ἐλπίς), of a promised blessing: Lc 24:49, At 1:14, Gl 3:22, Hb 6:12-17 10:36 11:13, 33 11:39; with genitive epexeg., At 2:33 Gl 3:14, Hb 9:15 (Cremer, 27).†
(AS)

G1861.def:
ἐπ-αγγέλλω
[in LXX: Et 4:8 (אָמַר), Pv 13:12, Wis.2:13, al. ;]
__1. to announce, proclaim.
__2. (a) to promise;
__(b) to profess. Mid., also frequently in both these senses;
__(with) to promise: with dab. of person(s), Hb 6:13; with accusative of thing(s), Rm 4:21, Tt 1:2; with dative of person(s) and accusative of thing(s), Tg 1:12 2:5, 2Pe 2:19; ἐπαγγελίαν, 1Jo 2:25; with inf., Mc 14:11, At 7:5; before λέγων, Hb 12:26; ptcp., Hb 10:23 11:11;
__(d) to profess: θεοσέβειαν, 1Tm 2:10; γνῶσιν, 1Tm 6:21. Pass., Gl 3:19 (cf. προ-επαγγέλλω; and see Cremer, 26).†
(AS)

G1863.def:
ἐπ-άγω
[in LXX for בּוֹא hi., etc. (29 words in all) ;]
to bring upon: with dative and accusative, 2Pe 2:5; ἑαυτοῖς ἐ. (for cl. mid., see Mayor, in l), 2Pe 2:1; ἐ. τὸ αἷμα (cf. Ge 209), At 5:28.†
(AS)

G1864.def:
ἐπ-αγωνίζομαι depon.;
__1. to contend with (Plut.).
__2. to contend for (C.I., 2335, 19): with dative of thing(s), Ju 3.†
(AS)

G1866.def:
Ἐπαίνετος (Rec. -τός), -ου, ὁ
Epænetus, a Christian of Borne: Rm 16:5.†
(AS)

G1867.def:
ἐπ-αινέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for הָלַל pi., שָׁבַח pi. ;]
to praise: with accusative, Rm 15:11, 1Co 11:22; before ὅτι, Lc 16:8, 1Co 11:2; absol., before ὅτι, 1Co 11:17.†
(AS)

G1868.def:
ἔπ-αινος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for תְּהִלָּה, etc. ;]
praise: Rm 2:29 Rm 13:3, 1Co 4:5, 2Co 8:18, Ef 1:6, 12 1:14, Fp 1:11 Fp 4:8, 1Pe 1:7 2:14.†
(AS)

G1869.def:
ἐπ-αίρω
[in LXX for נָשָׂא, רוּם, etc. ;]
to lift up, raise: τ. ἀρτέμονα, At 27:40; χεῖρας, Lc 24:50, 1Tm 2:8; κεφαλάς, Lc 21:28; ὀφθαλμούς, Mt 17:8, Lc 6:20 16:23 18:13, Jo 4:35 6:5 17:1; φωνήν, Lc 11:27, At 2:14 14:11 22:22; τ. πτέρναν (figuratively), Jo 13:18. Pass., At 1:9; metaphorically, to be lifted up with pride: 2Co 10:5 11:20.†
(AS)

G1870.def:
ἐπ-αισχύνομαι
[in LXX: Jó 34:19 (נָשָׂא), Sl 119:6 (בּוּשׁ), Is 1:29 A (חָפֵר) * ;]
to be ashamed (of): absol., 2Tm 1:12; with accusative of person(s), Mc 8:38, Lc 9:26; with accusative of thing(s), Rm 1:16, 2Tm 1:8 1:16; ἐπί, with dative of thing(s), Rm 6:21; with inf., Hb 2:11; with, accusative of person(s), and inf., Hb 11:16,†
(AS)

G1871.def:
ἐπ-αιτέω, -ῶ, [in LXX: Psa_109:10 (H7592) Sir_40:28 * ;]
__1. to ask besides.
__2. to beg (as a mendicant; cf. MM, Exp., xiv): Lc 16:3 18:35 (Cremer, 74).†
(AS)

G1872.def:
ἐπ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX (chiefly metaphorically) for אָחַר, הָלַךְ, etc. ;]
to follow after; in NT metaphorically; absol.: Mc 16:20 (illustrated by use in verifying accounts; see MM, Exp., xiv; Milligan; NTD, 78); with dative of person(s), of sins, 1Tm 5:24 (cf. Ellic. and CGT, in l); τ. ἴχνεσιν, 1Pe 2:21; ἔργῳ ἀγαθῷ, 1Tm 5:10.†
(AS)

G1873.def:
ἐπ-ακούω
[in LXX for שָׁמַע, עָנָה, etc. ;]
__1. to listen to.
__2. to hearken to, hear with favour (one's prayer): with genitive of person(s), 2Co 6:2 (LXX).†
(AS)

G1874.def:
ἐπ-ακροάομαι, -ῶμαι
to listen attentively: At 16:25 (cf. Page, in l).†
(AS)

G1875.def:
ἐπ-άν
conj. (ἐπεί, which see, ἄν)
later form of ἐπήν,
after, when: with subjc. Pres., Lc 11:34; with subjc. aor., Mt 2:8, Lc 11:22.†
(AS)

G1876.def:
ἐπανάγκης, -ες
(ἀνάγκη), only in neut.;
__1. ἐπάναγκες (sc. ἐστί), it is compulsory, necessary.
__2. As adv., of necessity: At 15:28.†
(AS)

G1877.def:
ἐπ-αν-άγω
[in LXX: Zc 4:12 (רוּק hi.), Sir.17:26 26:28, 2Ma.9:21 2Mac 12:4 * ;]
to bring up or back (sc. ναῦς); to put out to sea (DB, iii, 63b): Lc 5:3-4; intrans., to return: Mt 21:18.†
(AS)

G1878.def:
ἐπ-ανα-μιμνήσκω
to remind again: with accusative of person(s), Rm 15:15.†
(AS)

G1879.def:
ἐπ-ανα-παύω
[in LXX, mid., for נוּחַ, שָׁעַן ni ;]
to refresh, cause to rest (upon); mid., to rest upon: metaphorically, with dative, Rm 2:17; before ἐπί, with accusative, Lc 10:6 (Cremer, 827).†
(AS)

G1880.def:
ἐπ-αν-έρχομαι
[in LXX for שׁוּב, etc. ;]
to return: Lc 10:35 19:15.†
(AS)

G1881.def:
ἐπ-αν-ίστημι
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;]
to raise up against; mid., to rise up against: before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Mt 10:21, Mc 13:12.†
(AS)

G1882.def:
ἐπ-αν-όρθωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐπανορθόω, to correct, restore; of. 2Ma.2:22) [in LXX: I Et 8:52, 1Ma.14:34 * ;]
correction: of life, 2Tm 3:16 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)

G1883.def:
ἐπ-άνω
adv., [in LXX for מַעֲלָה, עַל, מֵעָל, etc. ;]
above;
__1. adverbially;
__(a) of place: Lc 11:44;
__(b) of number, more than: Mc 14:5, 1Co 15:6.
__2. As prep. C. genitive;
__(a) of place: Mt 2:9 5:14 21:7 23:18-22 27:37 28:2, Lc 4:39 10:19, Ap 6:8 20:3;
__(b) of pre-eminence: Lc 19:17-19, Jo 3:31.†
(AS)

G1884.def:
ἐπ-αρκέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 1Ma.8:26 1Mac 11:35 * ;]
__1. to be strong enough for.
__2. to ward off.
__3. to aid, relieve: with dative of person(s), 1Tm 5:10 5:16 (mid., WH, mg.).†
(AS)

G1885.def:
ἐπαρχεία (Rec. -χία, see Bl., § 3, 5), -ας, ἡ
(ἔπαρχος, a prefect), [in LXX: Et 4:11 (מְדִינָה), Jdth.3:6 A* ;]
the jurisdiction of a prefect, a province: At 23:3, 34 25:1.†
*†ἐπάρχεισς, -ον,
of a prefect: ἡ ἐ. (sc. ἐξουσία) = ἐπαρχεια, which see, At 25:1 (WH, mg.).†
(AS)

G1886.def:
ἔπ-αυλις, -εως, ἡ
(αὐλή), [in LXX for חָצֵר, טִירָה, (l.with), etc. ;]
a dwelling, habitation: At 1:20 (LXX).†
(AS)

G1887.def:
ἐπ-αύριον,
adv. [in LXX for מָחָר, Gn 30:33, elsewhere, Êx 9:6, al., for מׇחֳרָת ;]
on the morrow: in NT, ἡ ἐ. (sc. ἡμέρα), Mt 27:62, Mc 11:12, Jo 1:29, At 10:9, al
(AS)

G1888.def:
αὐτόφωρος, -ον
(αὐτός, φώρ, a thief) [in Sm.: Jó 34:11 * ;]
prop. with ref. to theft, then generally, in the very act: as freq., neut. dative after ἐπί, Jo 8:4 (Rec., ἐπαυτοφώρῳ).†
(AS)

G1890.def:
ἐπ-αφρίζω
to foam up: metaphorically, τ. αἰσχύνας, Ju 13.†
(AS)

G1892.def:
ἐπ-εγείρω
[in LXX for עוּר hi., קוּם hi., etc. ;]
to rouse up, excite: C. accusative of thing(s), διωγμόν, At 13:50; ψυχάς, At 14:2.†
(AS)

G1893.def:
ἐπεί
conj. (ἐπί, εἰ),
when, since;
__1. of time, when, after: Lc 7:1 (Rec., WH, mg.).
__2. Of cause, since, because: Mt 18:32 21:46 27:6, Mc 15:42, Lc 1:34, Jo 13:29 19:31, At 13:46 (Rec., WH, mg.), 1Co 14:12, 2Co 11:18 13:3, Hb 5:2, 11 6:13 9:17 11:11; ἐ. οὖν, Hb 2:14 4:6. With ellipsis, otherwise, else: Rm 11:6, 22, Hb 9:26; ἐ. ἄρα, 1Co 5:10 7:14; introducing a question, Rm 3:6, 1Co 14:16 15:29, Hb 10:2 (cf. 4Ma.1:33 4Mac 2:7 4Mac 2:10 4Mac 4:24-26).†
(AS)

G1894.def:
ἐπει-δή
conj.;
__1. of time, when now, after that: Lc 7:1 (WH, txt.).
__2. Of cause, seeing that, forasmuch as: Lc 11:6, At 13:46 (WH, txt., RV) At 14:12 15:24, 1Co 1:21-22 14:16 15:21, Fp 2:26.†
(AS)

G1895.def:
ἐπει-δή-περ
conj.,
forasmuch as ("a stately compound," frequently in cl. and suitable for the formal introduction of Lk): Lc 1:1.†
(AS)

G1896.def:
ἐπ-εῖδον 2 aor. without Pres. in use;
[in LXX chiefly for רָאָה ;] to regard with attention, look upon (in cl., of the gods)
__1. with a view to bless: with inf., Lc 1:25 (cf. DB, 136b).
__2. To punish: before ἐπί, At 4:29.†
(AS)

G1898.def:
ἐπ-εισ-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
a bringing in besides or in addition (Hipp., FlJ, al.): Hb 7:19 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)

G1899.def:
ἐπειτα, adv. of sequence
[in LXX: Nm 19:10 A, Is 16:2, 4Ma.6:3 * ;]
thereupon, thereafter, then: Lc 16:7, Gl 1:21, Tg 4:14; before μετὰ τοῦτο, Jo 11:7; μετὰ ἔτη τρία, Gl 1:18; διὰ δεκατεσσάρων ἐτῶν, Gl 2:1; πρῶτον . . . ἔ., 1Co 15:46, 1Ts 4:17, Hb 7:2; πρότεφον . . . ἔ, Hb 7:27; ἀπαρχὴ . . . ἔ., 1Co 15:23; εἶτα . . . ἔ., 1Co 15:5-6 (WH, txt.); . . . ἔ., 1Co 15:5-7 (WH, mg.); τρίτον . . . ἔ. (his), 1Co 12:28.†
(AS)
